assetContract.crossRecipeRule: Every recipe uses a distinct original non-celebrity model identity with no reuse.
assetContract.withinRecipeRule: Pinterest Pins, social images, cards, the website hero/final, and all eight tutorial steps show the same person and the same advertised makeup look.
assetContract.heroMaster: Crop-safe landscape 16:9 or 3:2 beauty master, at least 1536px wide before export and at least 2x the maximum rendered width in production; 720px-wide sources are forbidden.
assetContract.stepMaster: Eight independent cumulative 4:3 instructional states at 1280x960 or larger.
assetContract.publishGate: Identity drift, cross-recipe identity reuse, Pin-to-page mismatch, or makeup mismatch blocks publication.
